label: Tue 3 Nov 2026
headline: Today's sound headlines
lead: 30 new stories from 17 sound and audio news sources over the last 48 hours, including Sound On Sound, Production Expert, ProSoundWeb, FOH, TV Technology and 12 more. This edition is assembled automatically from the outlets' own feeds: titles and summaries are theirs, sorted into sections. Open a story for the full article.

items.title: ARA Plugins In 2026 - What’s Available And Why You Should Care
items.take: Since its beginnings in the early 2010s, ARA has since become the plugin format to be reckoned with. With an ever expanding pool of processors that can access the tech, here we roundup not only what’s out there, but also what ARA-enabled magic means for you and your timeline.

items.title: Myburgh launch the M28
items.take: Said to be the ideal choice for engineers in search of a mic with a sound of its own rather than a remake of a classic design, the M28 centres around a German-made CK12 capsule, but is said to offer a distinctive sound to your usual C12-inspired designs.

items.title: NEXO & Yamaha Team Up On Unique Sonic Upgrade At St. Frances Cabrini Catholic Church In Colorado
items.take: Integration firm AcousTech outfits sanctuary in Littleton known for its reverberant acoustics and wraparound seating with a new system incorporating M620, P12+, M1012 and M1025 loudspeakers working with a DM7 mixing console.

items.title: Mixxx could unlock free and open standalone DJing — but, like, stable
items.take: Daniel Schürmann of the long-running libre/free DJ software project Mixxx has a compelling proposal for uniting efforts to develop their DJ software on embedded hardware, from emerging cheap "open" hardware to DIY projects.

items.title: Steven Slate Audio VSX Horizon One: A Major Update for the Flexible VSX Ecosystem
items.take: The Steven Slate Audio VSX Horizon One expands the popular VSX headphone range, alongside the release of MSX for AirPods Pro and VSX 8.0.

items.title: ‘Combat Audio:’ Inside Dude Perfect’s Live Mix
items.take: Go behind the live mix of Dude Perfect’s Squad Games tour with FOH engineer Jeff Sandstrom. With no script, no rehearsal, and headset mics in front of the PA all night, see why Jeff calls the gig “Combat Audio” - and why he relies on Waves LV1 Classic to keep up with the action.

items.title: Oticon Reveal Now Available on VA Contract, Bringing Dual AI Technology to Veterans
items.take: Oticon’s Reveal hearing aid, powered by a Dual AI system that simultaneously processes speech and contextual sounds, is now available on the Department of Veterans Affairs contract.

items.title: BangZilla releases Wave Theory, a MIDI plugin that turns waveforms into melodies
items.take: BangZilla has released Wave Theory, a MIDI sequencer that turns the shape of a waveform into melodies for your software and hardware instruments. Created with UK instrument makers Boxed Ear, Wave Theory costs $59 / €49 / £49.

items.title: OFFBIT M1 Announced – E-Paper Display for Lens Charts, Crew Lists and Notes, Three-Week Battery
items.take: Barcelona-based startup OFFBIT has announced the M1, a small e-paper display for the camera department that replaces the paper lens chart on the camera body. It also holds the crew list, notes and a gallery of custom images, and everything is set up in a free iOS app.

items.title: Timbaland Sues Former Managers Alleging $15 Million Fraud Scheme
items.take: Timbaland files a $15 million lawsuit against his former managers, alleging fraud, breach of fiduciary duty, and civil theft, among other claims.

items.title: FTC and four states demand jury trial in BOTS Act lawsuit against Live Nation and Ticketmaster
items.take: The US Federal Trade Commission and four states have demanded a jury trial in their lawsuit against Live Nation and its ticketing subsidiary, Ticketmaster.

items.take: Pine DSP’s latest offering brings together a set of six virtual processors, houses them in a 500-series-style layout and complements them with a detailed horizontal editing panel.

items.title: How Bogren A-Class Vocal Recreates Type-A Vocal Sheen
items.take: Hoping to summon the elixir of noise-reduction hardware used with a twist, Bogren’s latest foray into the world of plugin effects for any instrument promises big studio sheen for voices and more. Here we strap A-Class Vocal across our tracks to see if its aeriated signature can deliver.

items.title: Signia Pure C&G MaX AI Hearing Aid Platform Now Available to Veterans Through VA, DoD, and IHS
items.take: Signia’s AI-powered Pure Charge&Go MaX hearing aid platform and Active Mini IX are now accessible to veterans and active-duty personnel through the VA, DoD, and Indian Health Service.

items.title: PSP Audioware releases ClassicQlite, a FREE British-style EQ plugin
items.take: PSP Audioware has released PSP ClassicQlite, a free British-style equalizer plugin for macOS and Windows, inspired by classic console designs, including early Neve EQs.

items.title: The techno originator, Juan Atkins, has died at 64
items.take: It's a loss that's beyond words. Juan Atkins, who coined the term "techno" and is often called "the originator," has died at 64. My deepest condolences to friends, family, and so many people I know who worked with and were inspired by this singular human being.

items.title: Never Too Soon (Or Is It?)—Mariah Carey Ramps Up the Ultra-Lucrative Christmas Machine, This Time with Gucci On Board
items.take: November is here, and so is Mariah Carey’s latest “It’s Time” video, featuring a deep cut for longtime fans, alongside a Gucci tie-up for the season.

craft.body:
This month's alliance of SFX libraries is a reminder that field recordings and designed sounds have real value, including as AI training data.

Keep a simple register of your original recordings: date, place, gear, and who holds rights. When you deliver sounds to a client, say in writing whether they get a licence for this production only or full ownership. It is the same discipline the big libraries use, scaled to one person.
craft.title: Treat your own recordings as assets
